core_obligations: The authors construct a polynomial-time coloring walk with dimension-independent sub-Gaussian parameter sqrt(40), using adaptive pivot phases, orthogonal increment decomposition and a corrected exponential potential controlling both large and small projected directions. Complete algorithm, local moment lemmas and original proof are retained; cited convex-body implications are context.
